output.subject: Your capital call on 1 Dec 2026
output.body: Dear Thomas, Atlas Growth V will call €150,000 on 1 Dec 2026. You have €40,000 in cash with us, so €110,000 still needs to be covered. My proposal: sell part of your ETFs. This realises gains. The tax would be about €7,108 with the partial exemption for equity funds, and up to €10,154 without it; your tax adviser confirms the exact amount. Tell me in the app if you would like to go ahead and I will call you to confirm. Best, Jonas
